problem_statement: Build a brand-new Account Settings page from scratch at the /settings route of this Mosaic Tailwind dashboard (Vite + React + react-router-dom v7). The route does not exist yet — today /settings renders nothing. Construct the full page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (left Sidebar + top Header) and reuse the site's Tailwind design system (the violet/gray tokens, the .btn / .form-input / .form-switch utility patterns, the white rounded card surfaces). The settings screen must present a left-hand tab rail with three sections — My Account, Notifications and Billing — where clicking a tab actually swaps the panel on the right: the default My Account panel shows a Personal Information form, and switching to Notifications must reveal a Notification Preferences panel with toggle switches. The page must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: The page sits inside the existing dashboard shell (left sidebar nav + top header), consistent with the Dashboard page
A page heading 'Account Settings' with a short descriptive subtitle such as 'Manage your profile, alerts and plan in one place.'
A vertical tab rail listing exactly three sections: My Account, Notifications and Billing
A default 'My Account' panel headed 'Personal Information' containing a profile form (full name, email, role, location) styled with the site's form-input utility
Clicking the Notifications tab swaps the right panel to a 'Notification Preferences' panel with labelled toggle switches (Email Alerts, Weekly Digest)
A Billing tab whose panel shows the current plan summary
The whole page fits a 390px mobile viewport with no horizontal scrolling

Each tab-rail button must carry a data-tab attribute identifying its section (data-tab="account" | "notifications" | "billing") so the tab controls are addressable and do not collide with the Header's Notifications bell
design_constraints: Reuse the site's existing Sidebar and Header partials to mount the page in the dashboard shell
Reuse the Tailwind design tokens and utility patterns already in the template (violet-500 accent, gray surfaces, .btn, .btn-sm, .form-input, .form-switch)
Do not introduce a new visual language or a second router/layout

Match the template's colour palette: violet accent violet-500 rgb(132,112,255)/#8470FF for the active tab and primary actions, blue rgb(21,93,252) links, gray surfaces (background #F3F4F6, borders #E5E7EB rgb(229,231,235)), body text slate rgb(31,41,55)/#1F2937 with muted rgb(107,114,128), Inter font, 8px card radius
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /settings 是空 route (element=<></>, 顶层注册于 layout 外), 无 catch-all; reference 完整实现 tab 切换 (activeTab state 驱动面板); bad 将 tab 按钮 onClick 改为 no-op 使切换失灵 (结构与默认 My Account 面板正常渲染，但点 Notifications 不会出现 Notification Preferences)。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。BrowserRouter 无 basename，vite 无 base，故 state_plan path 为 /settings。tab 按钮带 data-tab 属性以避开 Header 里同名 Notifications bell (严格选择器冲突)。
